items.title: Nasdaq Composite vs. Nasdaq-100: What Each Measures
items.summary: The Composite covers a broad set of Nasdaq-listed stocks; the Nasdaq-100 focuses on large nonfinancial companies. Each combines many stocks, whose weights determine their contributions to its return.
